d: 📄 Contract: 12 months, with potential for renewal

We're working with a bank in Bahrain that's looking for a hands-on developer to join its Core Banking & Back-Office Applications team!
If you enjoy building banking applications, solving technical problems and understanding what happens behind the scenes when a banking transaction is processed, this could be a great opportunity.
q: Hands-on development experience within banking or financial services.
A good understanding of banking transactions, debits and credits, settlement and reconciliation.
Strong SQL, API and back-end development experience.
Familiarity with core banking platforms such as Temenos T24, iMAL, FLEXCUBE, Ethix or Phoenix would be a big plus!
If you’ve worked on banking applications and enjoy solving technical problems that have a direct impact on day-to-day banking operations, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply with your CV and tell us a little about the banking applications you’ve personally developed, supported or enhanced.
The first step will be a conversation with the nineDots team to learn more about your experience and walk you through the opportunity.
r: Develop and enhance core banking applications, APIs and back-end services.
Work on systems supporting payments, deposits, lending and customer accounts.
Write and troubleshoot SQL queries, stored procedures and database components.
Investigate production issues and resolve transaction failures.
Collaborate with software vendors on enhancements, fixes and upgrades.
Support deployments, testing and data migration activities.

During Your Tenure As a Manager In Audit & Assurance, You Will Demonstrate And Develop Your Capabilities In The Following Areas
Builds trust and credibility by focusing on how to meet multiple stakeholder needs whilst providing constructive challenge on engagement issues.

Reviews documentation of flows of transactions and tests of relevant controls early in the audit cycle to allow for timely assessment of the planned audit approach and the entity's control environment.

Suggests mitigating testing when controls are found to be ineffective, without always having to consult with the senior manager or partner. Applies professional skepticism to consider the broader impact (e.g. fraud risks, communication with those charged with governance) on our audit when significant controls are found to be ineffective or other conditions may indicate possible misstatements.

Recognizes opportunities to add value, extend knowledge, increase impact and to provide exceptional stakeholder value through drawing expertise from across the firm and integrating specialists where appropriate as part of the core audit engagement team.

Actively participates in the group risk assessment scoping of work to be performed by component auditors. Prepares and reviews referral instructions on a timely basis that clearly set up the group auditor's expectations and evaluates responses from component auditors.

Runs file check regularly throughout the audit, checks all points have been cleared at the end of each audit and chooses an appropriate file structure for each engagement, including group engagements.
Engages early with scheduling and the extended engagement team. Clearly communicates expectations regarding responsibilities and deadlines to all members of the engagement team.

Communicates the project plan and any entity-related dependencies with the entity's management team so that they are aware, at the beginning of the audit, of any repercussions (e.g., deadlines, fees) due to deviations from this plan. Reconfirms their understanding with the entity's management team in advance of key deadlines.

Performs reviews with professional skepticism considering whether the results of testing sufficiently assess, test and objectively challenge the appropriateness and reliability of the assumptions and data used to support management's assertions.

Compliance with auditing and accounting standards, relevant laws and regulations (including specific local laws and regulations), ethical standards, independence requirements and the audit firm's quality control procedures.
q: Builds own understanding of our purpose and values; explores opportunities for impact.
Demonstrates strong commitment to personal learning and development; acts as a brand ambassador to help attract top talent.
Understands expectations and demonstrates personal accountability for keeping performance on track.
Actively focuses on developing effective communication and relationship-building skills Understands how their daily work contributes to the priorities of the team and the business.
Minimum 6+ years of experience in public accounting, auditing, audit management, budget, business plan, business strategy, preferably with big 4 Audit Firms.
Degree in Accounting or related field.

Extensive knowledge of best practice reporting and International financial reporting standards. Able to ensure that the applicable accounting and auditing standards have been consistently applied and obtains appropriate evidence to support the assessment that the financial statements have been prepared in in accordance with the applicable financial reporting framework.

Ability to develop one's own knowledge and the knowledge of others as it relates to Deloitte's tools and audit methodology and the applicable professional accounting and auditing standards through both formal learning and on-the-job training.
Ability to thoroughly review audit documentation for completeness, accuracy and adequacy while ensuring timely archiving of work papers.
International accounting qualification is required: CA, ACCA, or CPA.
Fluent in English (reading, speaking, and writing).
Preference will be given only to Bilingual candidates (Arabic/English).

d: Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager - Remediation projects, to join our team in Ahmadi, Kuwait, supporting the Kuwait Environmental Remediation Program (KERP).

You will play a pivotal role in delivering large-scale environmental restoration initiatives. With millions of square meters of contaminated land successfully remediated, this project represents a globally significant effort in sustainable environmental recovery.
This is an opportunity to contribute to transforming impacted land into safe, productive ecosystems while leading complex engineering operations.
q: Education: Full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from an accredited university
Minimum 5 years in oil & gas / refinery / petrochemical industries
Minimum 5 years in a similar Project Management role
Project-management experience delivering contaminated-land or contaminated-soil remediation projects.
Soil remediation technologies and execution strategies
Engineering and project management across full project lifecycle
Experience managing substantial contaminated-soil volumes and multiple concurrent remediation work fronts.
Experience in a Project Management Consultancy environment.
Experience representing or supporting a client organization in the oversight of specialist remediation contractors.
Experience coordinating remediation work within live or operational oil-field environments.
Experience in Kuwait or elsewhere in the Middle East.
You are a proactive and results-driven leader with the ability to manage complex projects and diverse teams. You bring:
Strong technical expertise and problem-solving abilities
Excellent stakeholder and client engagement skills
A structured and strategic approach to project delivery
Passion for sustainability and environmental restoration
You will be recognized as a subject matter expert, capable of guiding teams, resolving complex challenges, and delivering high-impact outcomes.
r: Lead the overall management, coordination, and oversight of assigned contaminated-soil remediation projects.
Take accountability for project scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, contractor performance, and remediation outcomes.
Develop and implement project delivery strategies for assigned remediation areas and work packages.
Oversee the planning and delivery of site characterization, excavation, segregation, handling, transportation, treatment, containment, validation, and close-out activities.
Manage specialist remediation contractors and technical service providers on behalf of the Client.
Ensure remediation activities are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual and environmental requirements.
Confirm that completed remediation work meets approved Remediation Target Criteria and project acceptance requirements.
Identify technical, environmental, operational, commercial, and delivery risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.
Coordinate remediation activities with oil-field operations, access requirements, existing infrastructure, and other operational constraints.
Provide accurate and timely reporting on project status, remediation quantities, treatment performance, schedule, costs, risks, and forecast outcomes.
Act as the primary technical interface with the Client.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring expectations are consistently met.
Proactively resolve scope, schedule, and performance issues.
Champion a strong HSE culture across all project phases.
Ensure OHSE requirements are embedded within design, procurement, and execution.
Ensure compliance with the Worley Project Management Plan (WPMP) and contract requirements.
Support claims mitigation and management strategies.
Monitor project costs and forecast outcomes, taking proactive measures to prevent overruns.
Promote Value Improving Practices (VIPs) to optimize capital efficiency.
Ensure adherence to Worley systems, policies, and procedures.
Maintain strong oversight of engineering deliverables and quality standards.
Lead and motivate multi-disciplinary and global teams.
Drive achievement of milestones and key project objectives.
x: Work on one of the world’s largest environmental remediation programs
Contribute to meaningful sustainability and environmental recovery initiatives
Be part of a globally recognized engineering and project delivery organization
Lead impactful, large-scale projects with long-term significance
